curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a sheltered therapist truly diagnose contentment without first surviving the messy chaos of the wider world?
curatedMovie.description: Feeling like an impostor whose patients never actually improve, quirky psychiatrist Hector leaves behind his comfortable routine and girlfriend Clara to wander the globe in pursuit of what makes people genuinely happy.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A warm, lighthearted quest that pairs comedic globe-trotting with thoughtful, low-stress reflection.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Peter Chelsom turns personal burnout into a scenic, open-hearted comedy that balances gentle philosophical questions with breezy, far-flung misadventures.

facts.title: Hector and the Search for Happiness
